archetypes.name: awk-invocation-fidelity
archetypes.rationale: The plan proposes a specific awk invocation pattern with -v mode, -v trailer_nr, and -v key variables; a reviewer must verify these variable names and the trailer_nr derivation formula match what lib-plan-optional-trailers.awk actually expects at HEAD.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check that the invocation pattern `awk -v mode=<mode> -v trailer_nr=<N> [-v key=<k>] -f lib-plan-optional-trailers.awk <fixture>` in the proposed test-trailer-awk.sh matches the actual variable names consumed inside lib-plan-optional-trailers.awk. Verify that the plan's proposed `trailer_nr` derivation formula (`awk 'NF { nr = NR } END { print nr + 0 }'`) produces the same value as what the .sh wrapper passes, and check for any off-by-one difference between `trailer_nr - 1` block-scan logic described in the plan and the awk source. Look for POSIX awk portability risks in the plan's described fixture shapes (e.g. whether `NF`-based last-line detection is safe under BWK awk on macOS). Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: regression-anchor-validity
archetypes.rationale: The plan asserts Gate A/B wiring is already resolved and pins specific token strings in SKILL.md, approval-gates.md, and discussion-rounds.md; a reviewer must verify those tokens actually exist at HEAD and that the DISCUSSION_MD binding follows existing *_MD patterns in test-design-structure.sh.
archetypes.prompt_body: Verify the plan's claim that Gate A/B wiring is 'already resolved' by checking that the tokens `gate-b-dedup-plan.sh`, `--snapshot-trailers`, and `--dedup` are present in the exact files named (skills/design/SKILL.md, skills/design/references/approval-gates.md, skills/design/references/discussion-rounds.md) at HEAD before any edits. Check whether `discussion-rounds.md` already has a corresponding `*_MD` binding variable in scripts/test-design-structure.sh or if a new DISCUSSION_MD variable must be introduced, and assess whether the plan's description of adding it 'if one is not already present' is precise enough to implement without ambiguity. Also confirm whether the plan's scope-file list omits any existing .sh files in skills/design/scripts/ that lack .md siblings but are not named in 'Files to modify/create', which would leave the script-md-siblings convention partially backfilled. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
